description: isometric pixel art building for a fantasy village builder game, bright vivid saturated colours, crisp dark outlines, a single isolated object on a plain background, part of a stone stronghold at the edge of a forest, made of grey hewn stone, heavy timber and iron, standing directly on bare ground with no ground tile, base or platform under it, the guild banner: a tall carved wooden pole on a round plinth of grey stone, flying a long deep-blue banner with a golden stag emblem, two smaller blue pennants on short poles beside it and an iron brazier with a small fire at its foot, no people and no figures
